description: This file contains functions related to retrieving and manipulating MAC addresses on embedded devices running OpenWrt. The functions include reading MAC addresses from various device-specific locations such as device tree, JSON configuration, partition data, and UCI configs, as well as utility functions for MAC address processing and bit manipulation.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Retrieves the device MAC label, first attempting to read from device tree and then falling back to the JSON configuration.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Extracts an encrypted MAC address from a specified partition using decryption utilities.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address by decrypting data from a partition using a specific key.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Reads MAC address stored in a UCI configuration on UBI partitions.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Reads a MAC address stored as text at a specific offset within an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads MAC address binary data from a partition at a given offset.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from a UBI volume.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Reads MAC address as ASCII from a given MMC partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from MMC storage.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the NIC part of a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the CID of an MMC device.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Converts a MAC address to EUI format (hex pairs separated by a separator).

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Unsets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the local Admin bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the multicast bit in a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Canonicalizes a MAC address string into a standard format.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree entry is enabled.
